attempts.summary: Configured node1 (OpenWrt) as a router between lan-a (node2, eth1/10.10.9.0/24) and lan-b (node3, eth2/10.10.8.0/24). Created UCI firewall zones 'lana' and 'lanb' with default forward=REJECT, plus a single rule permitting only TCP/5432 from lana to lanb; all other cross-network traffic (other ports, ICMP, and the reverse direction) is rejected. Assigned static addressing on node2/node3 via dedicated systemd-networkd .network files (higher-priority match than the existing DHCP=yes catch-all) with static routes to the peer subnet via node1. Verified the policy end-to-end (node2->node3:5432 succeeds, node2->node3 other port/ICMP fails, node3->node2:5432 fails), then completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on node1, node2, and node3, proving changed boot IDs and full recovery of interfaces, routes, firewall ruleset, and the TCP/5432-only policy after each reboot.
